summary: Feed s108_single is degraded for NDR: 22.9% of TCP sessions (24/105) are one-way, exceeding 10% threshold. NDR requires bidirectional traffic and will have incomplete session reconstruction.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding only one direction for ~23% of TCP sessions. Most likely asymmetric routing without bidirectional aggregation or SPAN/TAP feed covering only one side of the conversation, so return traffic is sent to a different tool port or dropped.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs both directions to reassemble TCP, track state, and detect C2/exfiltration. One-way sessions appear as incomplete flows, causing missed detections, false positives, and broken application identification.

recommended_fix.why: Aggregate both directions of each flow to the same NDR tool port (flow-aware aggregation) to restore complete bidirectional sessions required for NDR detection.
